metadata.title: fix(security): harden diagnostic and metrics endpoint defaults
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- **`/version`**: Require `require_admin_auth` instead of `require_auth`; restrict `_public_env()` to `MCPGATEWAY_`/`MCP_` prefixed vars + curated allowlist instead of dumping the entire process environment
- **`/health/security`**: Require `require_admin_auth` instead of manual JWT parsing that accepted any user
- **`/` (UI disabled)**: Remove `version` and `admin_api_enabled` from public root response
- **`/metrics/prometheus`**: Replace `instrumentator.expose()` (no auth) with custom endpoint using `Depends(require_auth)`; default `ENABLE_METRICS` to `false`; use `settings.ENABLE_METRICS` instead of `os.getenv` bypass
- **Token scoping**: Remove `/metrics` from `skip_paths`, add explicit `admin.metrics` permission patterns
- **Docker Compose**: Add `prometheus_token` service (monitoring profile) for scrape JWT generation with `user: "0"` for volume write permissions
- **Helm**: Add `metricsToken` secret reference to values/schema, update ServiceMonitor auth block, mount secret into Prometheus deployment
- **Docs**: Update observability, configuration, api-usage, and config schema files

## Test plan

- [ ] `make flake8 pylint` passes (10.00/10)
- [ ] 917 unit tests pass across all affected test files
- [ ] `helm template` renders successfully with schema validation
- [ ] Verify `/version` returns 401/403 for non-admin users
- [ ] Verify `/health/security` returns 401/403 for non-admin users
- [ ] Verify `/metrics/prometheus` returns 401 without JWT, 200 with valid JWT (when `ENABLE_METRICS=true`)
- [ ] Verify `/metrics/prometheus` returns 503 when `ENABLE_METRICS=false` (default)
- [ ] Verify `docker compose --profile monitoring up` generates Prometheus scrape token and Prometheus scrapes successfully
- [ ] Verify root endpoint (`/`) no longer includes `version` or `admin_api_enabled`

Closes #3460

reviews.author: Lang-Akshay
reviews.body:
## Security findings

| Finding | File | Line | Severity | CWE | Description |
|---------|------|------|----------|-----|-------------|
| F-1 | metrics.py:299 | 298–305 | Medium | CWE-306 | When ENABLE_METRICS=false, the metrics_disabled() fallback endpoint returns 503 without any auth dependency, allowing unauthenticated probing of config state. |
| F-2 | version.py:184 | 174–185 | Low | CWE-200 | `CORS_ORIGINS` in _PUBLIC_ENV_ALLOWLIST reveals trusted frontend domains. Behind admin auth, so acceptable risk. |
| F-3 | version.py:165 | 161–170 | Low | CWE-200 | _is_secret() keyword matching may miss unconventional secret var names (e.g. `CREDENTIAL`, `SIGNING`). Mitigated by allowlist-first approach in _public_env(). |
| F-4 | token_scoping.py:113 | 113–114 | Info | — | Metrics permission pattern [^/metrics(?:$ |
| F-5 | — | — | Info | — | No deny-path regression test for the metrics_disabled() unauthenticated endpoint. |

## Suggestions to address medium severity risk.

1. F-1 — Add Depends(require_auth) to the metrics_disabled() endpoint for defense-in-depth consistency. Effort: trivial. Ref: CWE-306, OWASP A01:2021.
----
### Not important 
2. F-2 — Consider removing `CORS_ORIGINS` from the allowlist. Effort: trivial.
3. F-3 — Add `"CREDENTIAL"`, `"PRIVATE"`, `"SALT"` to _is_secret() keywords as defense-in-depth. Effort: trivial.
---
## Test deny-Path Coverage

| Changed Endpoint | Deny-Path Test? | Gap |
|------------------|-----------------|-----|
| GET /health/security (now require_admin_auth) | Missing | No HTTP-level test for unauth (401) or non-admin (403) |
| GET /metrics/prometheus (now require_auth) | Missing | Auth overridden in all tests; no unauth denial test |
| GET /metrics/prometheus when ENABLE_METRICS=false | Missing | No test for disabled endpoint auth behavior |
| GET /version (now require_admin_auth) | Covered | test_version.py:145 asserts 401 |
| GET / root (info stripped) | Covered | test_main.py:541 asserts no version/admin fields |
| Token scoping RBAC for /metrics | Missing | No test for insufficient permissions denial |

commits.message:
fix(security): harden diagnostic and metrics endpoint defaults

- /version: require admin auth instead of any authenticated user
- /version: restrict _public_env() to MCPGATEWAY_/MCP_ prefixed vars + allowlist
- /health/security: require admin auth instead of any authenticated user
- / (UI disabled): remove version and admin_api_enabled from public response
- /metrics/prometheus: replace instrumentator.expose() with auth-gated endpoint
- /metrics/prometheus: default ENABLE_METRICS to false (opt-in)
- /metrics/prometheus: use settings.ENABLE_METRICS instead of os.getenv bypass
- Token scoping: remove /metrics from skip_paths, add permission patterns
- Docker Compose: add prometheus_token service for scrape auth
- Helm: add metricsToken secret ref, update ServiceMonitor and Prometheus mount
- Docs: update observability, configuration, api-usage, config schemas

Closes #3460

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(tests): use settings.ENABLE_METRICS in metrics buffer service tests

Tests were using monkeypatch.setenv which doesn't affect the already-loaded
Pydantic settings object. Switch to monkeypatch.setattr on settings directly.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(security): add auth to metrics_disabled endpoint and deny-path tests

- Add Depends(require_auth) to metrics_disabled() endpoint so
  unauthenticated callers cannot probe whether metrics are enabled
  (addresses reviewer finding F-1, CWE-306)
- Add deny-path regression tests for /metrics/prometheus (enabled +
  disabled) and /health/security unauthenticated access
- Fix test_setup_metrics_disabled to use monkeypatch.setattr on
  settings instead of stale os.environ patching

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(monitoring): add prometheus auth to debug/verbose compose and docs

- docker-compose-debug.yml: add ENABLE_METRICS=true, prometheus_token
  service and volume mount matching docker-compose.yml
- docker-compose-verbose-logging.yml: same treatment
- docs/manage/observability.md: add token generation step, auth header
  to curl example, authorization block to Prometheus scrape job example

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: address codex review findings for metrics hardening PR

- version.py: fix CORS_ORIGINS -> ALLOWED_ORIGINS in env allowlist
  (CORS_ORIGINS env var does not exist; runtime uses ALLOWED_ORIGINS)
- version.py: update endpoint summary and docstring to reflect
  admin-only access via require_admin_auth
- observability.md: fix stale "registered by Instrumentator" reference
- Helm values.yaml: default metricsToken to empty so ServiceMonitor
  and Prometheus do not reference a non-existent secret on first deploy
- All 4 compose files: fix invalid YAML in prometheus depends_on
  (cannot mix list and mapping syntax); convert to pure mapping with
  condition: service_completed_successfully for the one-shot token
  generator

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
